verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Grok can create and iteratively edit exportable media files: image generation, image editing with up to five source images, and video generation and editing. Its Google Drive connector can 'manage files' and Grok Bot works on a persistent cloud computer, but nothing shows document or presentation creation, iterative editing, or export. Missing for 10: documented document/presentation (e.g. docx/pptx/slides) creation, iterative editing of such files, export/download formats, and hands-on corroboration.
